summary: Independent regression verification of the expanded Trip Inspection damage categories (DENT/SCRATCH/TIRE/GLASS/LIGHT/PART). Full end-to-end flow PASSED on the preview environment using real Gemini (gemini-3.1-pro-preview). Bug is FIXED.
test_scope: Frontend-only, single happy-path regression around the user-reported bug (broken rear glass + broken brake lamp must now surface as NEW damage).
steps_executed: Logged in as admin@riyadah.tech / DamageAdmin#2026 (TENANT-000001) on https://damage-cases.preview.emergentagent.com -> POST /auth/login 200.
Navigated to /trip — Trip Inspection page loads; intro text mentions broken glass, broken lights, and broken/missing parts.

Uploaded /tmp/trip_before.png into [data-testid=trip-before-input] and /tmp/trip_after.png into [data-testid=trip-after-input]. Both file inputs are intentionally hidden (styled drop zones) — set_input_files works without waiting for visibility.
Clicked [data-testid=trip-analyze]. Observed network: POST /trip-inspection/session 200, two POST /trip-inspection/upload 200, POST /trip-inspection/analyze 200.
[data-testid=trip-result] rendered within timeout. Inspected innerText and DOM markers.

bug_fix_verification.summary_line: 'New damage found on rear window and left brake lamp.' — PASS

reset_behavior: Reset button cleared the result block (data-testid=trip-result removed from DOM). PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: No issues found in the slice tested. Hidden <input type='file' class='hidden'> with data-testid is fine — set_input_files works without visibility, but if any future tester uses locator.wait_for() with default visible=true it will time out. Consider adding a note or wrapping it with a more discoverable interaction surface.
seed_data_creation: None. Trip Inspection is ephemeral; nothing persisted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Trip Inspection bug fix (expanded categories GLASS/LIGHT/PART) confirmed working in preview against real Gemini. The file inputs trip-before-input and trip-after-input are hidden by design — use set_input_files directly without locator.wait_for(visible). The login form is NOT pre-filled on a fresh session, so always explicitly fill email + password before clicking submit and wait for URL to leave /login.
